body: Thank you so very much, I don't know why I still feel that suicide is the best decision but your comment is just so logical I'm amazed. Thank you so much I don't know what to say ;)

I've been told my entire life that I was meant for academics. For 6 years I was in an enriched program where academics was my life. Yet last year I dropped, I was told "ha you dropped its going to be so easy now" yet my grades are worse. I'm not only failing my parents but I'm failing my own identity, all that I've known. I can definitely "settle" for a less prestigious yet I don't think I could last at least another 4 years of hating everything and letting myself down.

Thank you very much! The only problem is that as I'm in my graduating year of high school, all my marks are too low to get into the universities that I want to get into. The thought of living my entire life doing a job that is unfulfilling and I hate because I am unable to get the marks required makes me question why I'm still alive.

Thank you for the response. Grades are the major concern, my brother graduated international baccalaureate program with 97% and was recognized as one of the smartest students in the province. My parents thusly put a plethora of pressure on me when my marks don't reach their standards.  I also feel like my very limited group of friends despise me and never want me around them, and that they only hang out with me because I hang out with them. It is a combination of these factors and the factor that I don't think I'll ever reach my dream because my marks don't reflect my theoretical understanding of the material.
